lane.name: Count
lane.description: Count one cycle count: count the lines in the zone, review the variances, get the Warehouse Manager's approval, and post the count adjustments. One run per cycle count. A rejected variance goes back to recount.

fields.description: Why the variances are rejected and the count must be recounted, entered at step 3.2 when the manager rejects them.

steps.name: Count the lines
steps.description: Count every line in the zone, bin by bin. CC-2026-001 is Zone A pick face (A-01-03, A-02-02, A-03-01): 5 lines. The Counting & Audit Agent proposes the expected quantities; the counter enters what is actually on the shelf.

steps.name: Verify the count
steps.description: Automatic check: every line has a counted quantity. A line with no count sends the run back to the count step.

check.message: Every line needs a counted quantity before the variances can be reviewed.

steps.name: Check the variances
steps.description: Automatic check: every line's counted quantity matches the expected quantity. CC-2026-001 has three variances (HG-1001 -2, HG-1003 +1, HG-1005 -2), so it goes to manager review. A count with no variance closes straight away.

check.message: Some lines have a variance - the Warehouse Manager reviews them.

steps.name: Review the variances
steps.description: The Warehouse Manager sees expected vs counted vs variance per line. Approve: the variances are accepted, the count is marked approved and the run posts the adjustments. Reject: nothing is posted and the run goes to the hold step.

steps.name: Record hold
steps.description: Record why the variances are rejected. Completing this step ends the run as held. Nothing is posted; the count stays COUNTING and a new run recounts it.

steps.name: Post count adjustments
steps.description: Post a COUNT_ADJUSTMENT StockMove per counted line for the variance (MV-2026-016 for HG-1001's -2 on CC-2026-001). Runs once per line. The ledger is append-only; a line with no variance posts no real adjustment - the runner skips zero-variance lines. Stock on hand moves by the variance.

steps.name: Close the count
steps.description: Close the count as APPROVED - the adjustments are posted (or there were none) and the count is approved. This step sets APPROVED again on the variance path, where the approval already set it, because the no-variance path never runs the approval; setting a status to the value it already has is harmless.
